description: "History of the United Netherlands from the Death of William the Silent to the Twelve Year's Truce--1609" by John Lothrop Motley is a historical account written in the 19th century. The book explores the tumultuous period following the death of William the Silent, focusing on the conflict between the Spanish monarchy and the Dutch provinces as they sought independence.
